subject: Ancestral states pies one subset at a time?

messages.author: 493d695f0e28df7a
messages.subject: Ancestral states pies one subset at a time?
parts:
Can one draw the ancestral states on a tree only one subset at a time? I have a gigantic data set and R is giving me the "Error: C stack too close to the limit" message.

So, I thought, maybe I could draw them on the tree on small portions at a time.

Does that work?
